'''February 2001 Pleasanton tournament (10 February)''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Warmasters, Pleasanton, California on 10 February 2001. [[Kevin Shannon]] won it. It is known from Nick Stefanko's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1721">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-02-12-pleasanton-ca-2-10-01d1721/ pleasanton-ca-2-10-01], DeckTech (Nick "JediBrain" Stefanko, 12 February 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-02-12-pleasanton-ca-2-10-01d1721/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 10 February 2001
* '''Site:''' Warmasters, Pleasanton, California
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Players:''' 11
* '''Winner:''' [[Kevin Shannon]]
